title: Ambush on the Coast Road
summary: Cloth merchant Alden Reed's cart lies overturned on the forest road. The tracks are fresh, the woods are too quiet, and something is watching from the eastern treeline.

theme.label: Roadside Rescue
theme.narration: Tell a grounded heroic-fantasy rescue story. Keep Alden Reed's disappearance and the eastern trail present through every fight, and let the party's choices determine how the rescue unfolds.

scenes.title: Ambush on the Coast Road
scenes.objective: Survive the ambush, drive off or defeat the goblins, and find out what happened to Alden Reed.
scenes.storyAnchor: Alden Reed, the cloth merchant, is missing - not trapped beneath the overturned cart. A small boot print and woodsmoke from the eastern woods point toward a goblin abduction; the ambush is keeping the party from following that trail.
scenes.opening: The Coast Road bends through old pines, and that is where you find it: Alden Reed's cloth cart tipped onto its side, one wheel still lazily spinning. Bolts of dyed cloth spill across the dirt like a wound. There is no Alden, no horse, no blood — only a single boot print pressed into the mud, too small to be a man's, and a smell of woodsmoke drifting from the east. The forest has gone silent. Somewhere in the treeline, a bowstring creaks. Roll for initiative — and tell me: what do you do?
openingChoices: Take cover behind the overturned cart
Shout into the treeline — reveal yourselves!
Nock an arrow and scan the shadows

monsters.name: Vesh Far-Eye
monsters.personality: Patient, vain about impossible shots, and quick to blame a poor angle.
monsters.storyHook: Vesh recognizes the marked trade maps but has never met the buyer who supplied them.

monsters.name: Rikkit Quickheel
monsters.personality: Restless, competitive, and always trying to prove faster than the others.
monsters.storyHook: Rikkit carried messages between the road ambush and the ravine camp.

monsters.name: Tallow
monsters.personality: A nervous scavenger who acts cruel only when backed by stronger goblins.
monsters.storyHook: Tallow cut the merchant's harness and knows the captive was taken east alive.

monsters.name: Snaggletooth
monsters.personality: A swaggering bully whose confidence cracks as soon as the ambush turns against him.
monsters.storyHook: Snaggletooth carries orders from an unnamed patron who paid to close the coast road.

scenes.afterword: With the goblins scattered, the woodsmoke to the east marks their bolt-hole — a shallow ravine where the missing merchant must be. The DM grants a story award for surviving the ambush and reading the road true. Catch your breath, bind your wounds, and follow the smoke — stronger than you arrived.

scenes.title: The Ravine
scenes.objective: Rescue Alden Reed from the goblins' bolt-hole. Named wolves prowl the camp, and Snaggletooth is cornered by the cages.
scenes.storyAnchor: Alden Reed is visible alive, bound and gagged beside the eastern cage. The party must break through Ashfang, Cinder, and Snaggletooth's named camp crew to reach him; stolen crates and an organized camp suggest this raid is bigger than roadside robbery.
scenes.opening: The woodsmoke leads you to a scar in the earth — a shallow ravine walled in cold stone, its floor littered with stolen crates. A cookfire guts and spits by the far wall. Beside it, lashed to a stake beside a crude wooden cage, slumps Alden Reed — alive, gagged, furious. Ashfang, an old grey wolf, and the younger black wolf Cinder lift their heads from a stripped carcass and go very still. Muckpot the cook grips a scimitar. Krell Hook-Ear watches the cage. From behind it, Snaggletooth snarls orders: he survived the road, and he is done running. This time, nobody is hidden. Roll for initiative!
openingChoices: Rush the cage to free the merchant
Kick the cookfire into the crates

props.name: Alden Reed
props.personality: Observant, stubborn, and furious that fear has kept him silent.
props.storyHook: Alden saw marked maps in the stolen crates and heard Snaggletooth argue with a hooded buyer.

monsters.name: Ashfang
monsters.personality: Old, watchful, and more protective of Cinder than loyal to any goblin.
monsters.storyHook: Ashfang may break from the fight if Cinder falls or Muckpot yields.

monsters.name: Cinder
monsters.personality: Fast, hungry, and reckless whenever Ashfang is threatened.
monsters.storyHook: Cinder follows Ashfang's lead and fears the cookfire.

monsters.name: Muckpot
monsters.personality: Complaining and sharp-tongued, but genuinely protective of the two wolves.
monsters.storyHook: Muckpot knows where the camp ledger is hidden and may bargain to protect Ashfang and Cinder.

monsters.name: Krell Hook-Ear
monsters.personality: Disciplined, wary, and loyal only while Snaggletooth still looks likely to win.
monsters.storyHook: Krell overheard the hooded buyer promise a second payment and may surrender if isolated.

monsters.name: Snaggletooth
monsters.personality: Humiliated by the failed road ambush, furious, and now visibly afraid of disappointing his patron.
monsters.storyHook: Cornered, Snaggletooth may reveal who paid him before accepting defeat.

scenes.afterword: Alden Reed, freed, wrings your hands and swears a debt no coin can cover. The ravine's stolen crates hold more than cloth — maps, marked in a hand no goblin wrote, of every road into the valley. Someone was PAYING Snaggletooth to close this road. But that... is a story for your next campaign.
